description: This Go source file defines REST storage setup for Kubernetes networking resources, including functions to initialize storage for different API versions and resource types such as network policies, ingresses, ingress classes, IP addresses, and service CIDRs.

classes.name: RESTStorageProvider
classes.description: Provides REST storage for Kubernetes networking resources, supporting multiple API versions.

methods.name: NewRESTStorage
methods.description: Creates new REST storage for the API group, supporting v1 and v1beta1 versions.

methods.name: v1Storage
methods.description: Initializes storage for v1 API resources such as network policies, ingresses, ingress classes, IP addresses, and service CIDRs.

methods.name: v1beta1Storage
methods.description: Initializes storage for v1beta1 API resources such as IP addresses and service CIDRs.

methods.name: GroupName
methods.description: Returns the API group name for networking resources.
